description.text: Teaching Objectives The course aims to educate students to study basic theory and elementary knowledge in medicine, gain basic clinical skills of some common diseases diagnosis processing, have the primary treatment ability to urgent, difficult and severe symptoms, and be qualified for careers in hospitals, the medical and health units, medical science research departments as well as other organizations related medicine.

duration.text: The Clinical Medicine at Xiamen University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 5277 USD/per year ￥ 38000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport 2.High school academic transcript 3.High school graduate certificate 4.Photocopy English Proficiency Certificate or medium-of-instruction certificate. 5.Personal Statement Write a personal statement (minimum 800 words) in Chinese or English, which should include a self-introduction, a description of your educational experience, your motivations for studying inChina, and your study plan. 6. Photocopy of Foreigner Physical Examination Form 7. Statement of Financial Support certifying that the applicant has sufficient funds to cover his or her tuition, accommodation and living expenses. It should be accompanied by an employment certificate or income certificate and a photocopy of the valid passport of the financial sponsor.

requirements.text: 1. High school graduate or above, or have passed Grade Twelve (10+2)/FSc./A Level/WAEC or equivalent. 2. Aged 18 or above and with a good health. 3. No Chinese-citizen with foreign passport.
